conceptBlocks.text: 什么是 RFM 客户分层？
最近消费距截止日越短通常代表近期活跃；频率是订单数，金额为期间净额。

items: 三个指标属于不同量纲，先各自分档再加总，不能把天数、次数和金额直接相加。
五等分按排序后的行数分配，不是固定金额区间；并列值可能因客户编号被分到不同组。

syntax.purpose: 客户消费分层的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 2025年有有效线上订单的客户；截止2025-12-31；一客户一行。按最后消费日期、订单数、净额分别降序。5分最高，总分至少13为高价值，至多6为低活跃，其余常规。原企业日期维度以2023-01-01为索引0，2025-12-31索引1095；其他数据集不可直接套常数。

methodBlocks.text: MAX 取最后一单日期，COUNT(*) 在订单粒度数订单，SUM 汇总金额。NTILE(5) 从第一档到第五档分配行，6减档号使高排名得高分。最后通过日期维度换算距截止日天数；
独立教学查询以 julianday 计算相同日期差。固定阈值分档用 CASE；保留同金额名次用 DENSE_RANK，评分和排名不混为一谈。

breakdown.title: 客户最近购买、次数及金额
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 先算出 2025 年每位线上客户的最近购买日期、订单数 freq 和净消费额 money。
breakdown.reason: 三项指标都是客户层面的，所以先汇总到一位客户一行。

breakdown.title: 为三项指标分别分档
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 给三项指标分别打 5 档分：最近购买越晚、订单越多、金额越大得分越高，5 分最高。
breakdown.reason: NTILE(5) 把客户平均分成五份，不是按并列名次；“最近”要用最近购买日期降序才能得高分。

breakdown.title: 按分档得分划分客户层级
breakdown.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id,1095-d.day_index recency_days,freq,money net_cents,r_score,f_score,m_score,CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day ORDER BY net_cents DESC, recency_days, freq
breakdown.purpose: 把三项得分相加：总分至少 13 为高价值，至多 6 为低活跃，其余为常规。
breakdown.reason: 层级由总分决定；天数以 2025-12-31 为截止日来算，其他数据集不能照搬同样的日期常数。

resultBlocks.text: 小型五人样例：客户1最近当天消费、两次共8000分，三项均5分；客户2得12分而非高价值；客户4、5分别6、3分属于低活跃。这只是演示分档，五人过少不能据此判断真实客户价值。
原企业客户12距截止日20天，分数4、3、3总计10，为常规；分层取决于样本与规则，不能认定低活跃就是流失或高价值就是高利润。

extensions.label: 客户三项指标

explanationBlocks.text: 最近日期、订单数、净额均先聚合到客户粒度。

extensions.sql:
WITH v_order_net(customer_id,order_date,net_cents,channel) AS (
 SELECT 1,'2025-12-31',5000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-12-20',3000,'online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,'2025-12-20',6000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-10-01',3000,'online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,'2025-06-01',2000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 5,'2025-01-01',1000,'online'
), a AS (
 SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money
 FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id
), b AS (
 SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,
 6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,
 6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a
)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY last_day

extensions.label: 完整分层查询

explanationBlocks.text: 以固定截止日换算天数，按总分分类。

extensions.sql:
WITH v_order_net(customer_id,order_date,net_cents,channel) AS (
 SELECT 1,'2025-12-31',5000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-12-20',3000,'online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,'2025-12-20',6000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-10-01',3000,'online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,'2025-06-01',2000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 5,'2025-01-01',1000,'online'
), a AS (
 SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money
 FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id
), b AS (
 SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,
 6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,
 6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a
)
SELECT customer_id,CAST(julianday('2025-12-31')-julianday(last_day) AS INTEGER) recency_days,freq,money net_cents,r_score,f_score,m_score,CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment FROM b ORDER BY recency_days DESC

extensions.label: 金额固定阈值和同额排名

explanationBlocks.text: 金额达到6000为高档，3000至不足6000为中档，其他低档。排名按金额，同额应同名次。

extensions.sql:
WITH v_order_net(customer_id,order_date,net_cents,channel) AS (
 SELECT 1,'2025-12-31',5000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 1,'2025-12-20',3000,'online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 2,'2025-12-20',6000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 3,'2025-10-01',3000,'online' UNION ALL
 SELECT 4,'2025-06-01',2000,'online' UNION ALL SELECT 5,'2025-01-01',1000,'online'
), a AS (
 SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money
 FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id
), b AS (
 SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,
 6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,
 6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a
)
SELECT customer_id,money,CASE WHEN money>=6000 THEN '高' WHEN money>=3000 THEN '中' ELSE '低' END amount_band,DENSE_RANK() OVER(ORDER BY money DESC) amount_rank FROM a ORDER BY money

comparison.text: 固定消费阈值利于跨期比较；相对五等分利于本期相对比较。样本少于五人时未必出现全部档位。

example.text: 按距上次消费天数降序直接赋高分，或将并列五等分当作同名次。

reason.text: 把“距上次消费的天数”按降序直接打高分，会让很久没来的客户得 5 分，方向反了；五等分会把并列的客户拆到不同档，不等于并列名次。

correction.text: 最近日期降序或距截止日天数升序；按业务要求选择五等分或并列排名。
